Display Views — Calendar

Calendar — See your due dates by the month.

Tasks are placed in the cell for their due date, so you can see this month's deadline balance at a glance — no more end-of-month scrambling.

Deadlines placed on the monthly calendar

Tasks appear in the cell for their due date, so you can see this month's deadline balance at a glance

Color-coded risk level

Overdue highlighted in red, due today in orange — nothing gets missed

See what's ahead clearly, even at month-end

Count badges for this month and next, plus real tasks shown in the surrounding months' cells too. A 7-week rolling view that also shows last week is available

One click to Backlog

Click a task to open the corresponding issue instantly

See the deadline rush coming.

Spot deadline clustering early with the monthly calendar, and get a head start with plenty of room to spare.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
